task: Create a docx summary file named class_summary.docx with a list of all students who are in Class 3, including their names. The summary should have the title 'Class 3 Student List' at the top. Ensure all names from Class 3 in class_member.xlsx are listed in the file.
query_sentence: Prepare a document summarizing the students in Class 3 based on the class_member.xlsx data.

ground_truth_memory.info: The output file for the summary should be named class_summary.docx and saved in the data folder.
